<entry id="K00538">
<head-word>כִּילּוּי</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (כָּלָה) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>finishing</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra K’dosh. ch. I; Y. Peah IV, 18

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>extinction, destruction</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 7, beg. (ref. to שמד, Deut. IX, 20) כ' בנים וכ' the extinction of his family; ib. s. 10. Mekh. Bo s. 8 מצות כִּילּוּייוֹ בכל דבר it (the leavened bread) may be destroyed in any manner, opp. מצות כ' בשריפה it must be destroyed by fire.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>destruction</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—*כּילּוּי סִילְוֵי (or סִילְיֵי) 
<italic>destruction of thistles</italic>, name of an insect, prob. 
<italic>caterpillar</italic> (or 
<italic>bruchus</italic> (?), v. Sm. Ant. s. v.). Gen. R. s. 51, beg. (expl. שבלול, Ps. LVIII, 9) [read:] כהדין כ' סיליי כשלשול וכ' [לימצא is a gloss borrowed from a comment. to Ps. l. c. and absent in Yalk. Ps. 776] like the caterpillar, like the abdominal secretion &c. Y. Shek. VI, 50
<sup>a</sup> top כקרני סיליי וכיליי (Bab. ed. to VI, 2 Ms. M. סילוי וכילוי, early ed. only ס') the water coming forth from the Temple (Zech. XIV, 8) will be … as minute as the horns (feelers) of the caterpillar (thinner than those of חגבים).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00566">

<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (כָּנָה) 
<italic>by-name, surname; attribute, substituted word</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. VII, 5 דנין … בכ' the witnesses are examined by using a substitute for the Divine Name (v. יוֹסֵי). Sot. VII, 6 במקדש … ובמדינה בכִינּוּיוֹ in the Temple the Divine Name is pronounced as it is written, in the country (outside the Temple) by its substitute (Ădonai). Ib. 38
<sup>a</sup> בכ', opp. שם המפורש; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. כִּינּוּיִים, כִּינּוּיִין, כִּנּ'</plural-form>. Ned. I, 1 כִּינּוּיֵי נדרים words used as substitutes for vows (נדר); ib. 2 כ' לחרם substitutes for 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>erem</italic> (v. חֵרֶק); a. fr.—כִּינּוּיֵי כִּינּוּיִין secondary substitutes, e.g. the use of 
<italic>g’rog’roth</italic> for 
<italic>tirosh</italic> and this for 
<italic>eshkol</italic>, v. גְּרוֹגֶרֶת. Tosef. Naz. II, 1; Y. ib. II, beg. 51
<sup>d</sup></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00568">
<head-word>כִּינּוּס, </head-word>
<head-word>כִּנּ'</head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (כָּנַס) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>gathering, piling up.</italic></definition>
<notes> Kel. XV, 5 העשוי לכ' a vessel used for piling up (shovel &c.), opp. לקבלה as a receptacle. Nidd. 49
<sup>b</sup> כ' ע"י הדחק receiving (absorbing) liquids under pressure (through pores, perforations &c.) B. Bath. 68
<sup>a</sup> בית כ' העצים (Ms. O. כּוֹנֵס; Tosef. ib. III, 3 כְּנִיסַת) store-room for wood. Snh. VIII, 5 כ' לרשעים כו' gathering (living together) of the wicked is bad &c., opp. פִּיזּוּר. Y. Kidd. I, 59
<sup>d</sup> top מקום כ' שיער a spot of the body where hair grows in quantities. Gen. R. s. 32 (ref. to Gen. VII, 5) זה שיכון לכ' וכ' this is the execution of the command to gather in the animals. Midr. Till. to Ps. VIII (ref. to ויצר, Gen. II, 19) לשון כ' it means the gathering (the animals before Adam); Gen. R. s. 17 וכאן לכבוש (corr. acc.); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. כְּנֶסֶת) 
<italic>retirement for prayer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. s. 84, beg. (ref. to קבוציך, Is. LVII, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition />
<notes> כִּינּוּסוֹ וכ' בניו וכ' his (Jacob’s) and his sons’ prayers saved him &c.; Yalk. Gen. 140; Yalk. Is. 349.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00603">
<head-word>כִּיפָּה, </head-word>
<head-word>כִּפָּה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> כָּפַף)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>arch, doorway, bow</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 80
<sup>b</sup> עושה כ' forms a bow (when urinating). Yoma 11
<sup>b</sup>; Erub. 11
<sup>b</sup> כ' ר"מ וכ' as to an arched doorway R. M. says, it requires a M’zuzah. Tosef. ib. VII (V), 2 עד מקום הכי' (ed. Zuck. הקופא) to the site of the (now ruined) arch (of Tiberias); Y. ib. V, 22
<sup>d</sup> bot. עד הכ'. Y. Naz. VII, 56
<sup>a</sup> top הגיעו לכ' when they arrived at the arch (or arcade). Ab. Zar. I, 7 (16
<sup>a</sup>) כ' שמעמידין וכ' the arched chamber in the bath where they put up idolatrous statues. Pesik. R. s. 41 כ' של חשבונות … אותה כ' an arcade named Arch of Accounts (a sort of Exchange) existed outside of Jerusalem, and they used to go out and settle their accounts under this arcade &c. Tanḥ. B’shall. 17 (ref. to קפאו, Ex. XV, 8) כמין כפה (Mekh. ib., Shir. s. 6 קופה) like a vault; a. e.—Esp. כִּיפַּת הרקיע, or כִּופָּה 
<italic>the heavenly arch, sky</italic> (believed to be a solid mass). Gen. R. s. 48, beg. Ib. s. 4 הרקיע … ולמעלה … כ' וכ' the firmament is like a lake, and above the lake is the arch, and owing to the heat of the lake the arch exudes drops &c. B. Bath. 25
<sup>b</sup> אחורי כ' back of (above) the sky. Meg. 11
<sup>a</sup> ג' מלכו תחת הכ' Ms. M. 2 (ed. בכ', Ms. M. 1 בקופה) three persons ruled over the whole world; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>a vaulted chamber, prison</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. IX, 3 כונסין אותן לכ' they put them in prison (for life). Ib. 5.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>skull-cap, cap</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Gitt. IV, 45
<sup>d</sup> bot.; Bab. ib. 20
<sup>a</sup>; v. אנדכתרי; Treat. ʿĂbadim ch. III (ed. Kirchh.) קיפה. Sabb. 57
<sup>b</sup> כ' של צמר a woolen cap, v. כָּבוּל II. Y. ib. V, end, 7
<sup>c</sup> כ' של צמר a woolen cap on the head of a lamb, v. חָנוּן I; a. e.—Tosef. Mikv. IV, 5, v. infra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (cmp. קוּפָּה) 
<italic>heap, pile</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Snh. X, 27
<sup>d</sup> bot.; Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>c</sup> top כ' של אבנים a heap of stones; Gen. R. s. 100 כִּיפַּת אבנים. Ḥull. 129
<sup>a</sup> כִּיפַּת שאור וכ' a heap (lump) of leavened dough which one intended to use as a block to sit on; Pes. 45
<sup>b</sup> כופת some ed. (corr. acc.; Ms. M. 2 כי'; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90); v. כּוֹפֶת.—
<plural-form>Pl. כִּיפִּין, כִּפִּים</plural-form> (or כֵּיפִ' fr. כֵּיף) a) 
<italic>top-branches</italic> (
<italic>arches</italic>) 
<italic>of palm-trees</italic>. Tosef. Shebi., VII, 16 על (של) בין הכֵּיפִ' ed. Zuck. (Var. על מה שבכי', שבכופין); Pes. 53
<sup>a</sup> על של בין הכ' as long as there are fruits in the tops. Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 1 שכיפת שתי כ' של תמרה וכ' (R. S. to Kel. XXII, 9 כופות) who tied together two palm branches and sat upon them. Sabb. XXIV, 2 מפספסין את הכ' you may spread the bunches of branches (for fodder), contrad. to זִירִין a. פְּקִיעִין. Ib. 155
<sup>a</sup> כ' תלתא bunches are called 
<italic>kippin</italic> when tied with three bands.—b) 
<italic>billow-crests, surf</italic>. Sot. 34
<sup>a</sup>. Ḥag. 19
<sup>a</sup>; Ḥull. 31
<sup>b</sup> אין מטבילין בכ' you must not immerse vessels in the surf (caps of waves), contrad. to ראשין; Tosef. Mikv. IV, 5 בכיפא ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. בכיפה).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00617">
<head-word>(כִּיד) כִּיר</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Pi.</italic> (כִּיֵּיד) כִּיֵּיר (denom. of כִּירָה II or of כַּד II) [
<italic>to do the work of the stove-setter</italic> or 
<italic>of the potter</italic> (כַּיָּיר or כַּיָּיד, v. 
<xref rid="B01294">בִּרְכַּיָּיר</xref>),] 
<italic>to cement; to lay out with tiles, panels</italic> &c. [Ar.</definition>
<notes> reads ר, editions mostly ד.] B. Kam. 51
<sup>a</sup> bot. אחד … וסייד וכ' (Ms. F. וסייר וכייר) if one dug a pit ten handbreadths deep, and another came and lined it with plaster and cemented it; Mekh. Mishp., N’zik., s. 11. Ab. Zar. III, 7 (47
<sup>b</sup>) סיידו וכִיְּירוֹ לאליל Mish. (Bab. ed. וכיידו לע"ז) he plastered the room and put tiles on (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Abacus) designing it for idolatrous purposes. Ib. סיידה וכִיְּירָהּ וכ' (Ms. M. וציירה) if one plastered and stuccoed a stone (slab) for an idolatrous purpose. Gen. R. s. 28 סיידה וכיירה וציירה he plastered and panelled and painted the wedding chamber; Lam. R. to IV, 11 וכיידה. Tosef. Sot. VIII, 7 כִּיְּירוּהוּ וסיידוהו וכ' (Var. כִּיְּדוּהָ, כִּיְּרוּהָ) they panelled the stone and stuccoed it and wrote upon it. B. Bath. 60
<sup>b</sup> אין מסיידין ואין מְכַיְּירִין וכ' we must not decorate our rooms with plaster, panels and paintings in these days (after the destruction of the Temple); Tosef. ib. II, 17.—Part. pass. מְכוּיָּיר, f. מְכוּיֶּירֶת. Ib.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<plural-form>pl.) Ms. M. (ed. כַּלְיָיא</plural-form> ch.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Men. 107

<sense>

<sup>b</sup> כלו כל הקצין all the predicted terms of redemption are ended (have passed by); a. fr.—[Pesik. R. s. 12 מת וכלה בקבר, read: ובלה.]—Part. (fr. כּוּל, cmp. חוּל, part. חולות a. חלות) כָּל. Snh. 17
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to כלאם, Num. XI, 28) הטל … והן כָּלִין מאליהם throw upon them the care for the public, and they will cease (to prophesy) of themselves; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>

<definition>
<italic>to finish, cease</italic>.</definition>

<sup>b</sup> (ref to Lev. XVI, 20) אם כפר כ' when he has atoned (for the sanctuary &c.), he has finished (his task). Ib. אם כ' כפר when he has done all (the prescribed ritual), he has achieved atonement; Sifra Aḥăré ch. IV, Par. 4; a. e.—Tanḥ. Vayetse 2 מְכַלִּין את שדותיהן they reap their fields entirely (leaving no corners for the poor). Snh. 67
<sup>b</sup> כַּלֵּה מִדַּבְּרוֹתֶיךָ ולך וכ' (some ed. כלך, v. Rab. D. S. a. l. note) cease from thy homiletical interpretations, and turn to &c.; Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 6; Ex. R. s. 10, v. כַּלֵּךְ.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to finish, destroy</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> שכִּילַּתּוֹ וכ' it consumed &c. Pesik. R. s. 2 שכי' אותה וכ' whom the Lord destroyed. Num. R. s. 3 היה הארון מְכַלֶּה בבני וכ' the Ark made havoc among the sons of Kehath (who had charge of it; cmp. II Sam. VI, 7). Mekh. B’shall., Amalek, s. 2 לכַלָּן to destroy them. Y. Ḥag. II, 78
<sup>a</sup> bot. (cited in Tosaf. to Ḥag. 17
<sup>b</sup> a. v. אלא) ובלבד שיְכַלֶּה עיסתו (ed. שיבלים) provided he has used up all his dough for the day; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְכוּלֶּה, pl. מְכוּלִּין. Pesik. Shek., p. 13
<sup>b</sup> כבר היו ישראל מ' וכ' Israel would then have been destroyed; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<senses>
<sense>

<sup>b</sup> מַכְלֵי להו מִכּוּלָּהּ וכ' Ar. a. Tosaf. (ed. מכלליה, read: מכלי ליה) kept the cattle off from the entire field (in which he walked); (ed.: kept himself aloof from the entire pasture ground). B. Bath. 5
<sup>a</sup>, v. next w.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>כַּלֵּי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>

<italic>buy</italic> another ass for the carcass, but not hire one. Ib. Ms. M. לכַלּוּיֵי קרנא לא חיישינן (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8) and as for using up the stock, we need not take that into consideration. B. Kam. 3
<sup>a</sup> דמְכַלְּיָא קרנא when the obnoxious subject destroys the object itself (not only the fruits).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
